title: C++: The Documentary
summary: A documentary released by Herb Sutter chronicling the history, evolution, and significance of the C++ programming language, showcasing its journey from creation to modern day relevance.
problem_solved: Documents the history and evolution of C++ for the developer community.
why_valuable: Provides authoritative insights from a C++ standards committee chair about a language that remains critical in systems programming, game development, and performance-critical applications.
